description: This file defines a React component for the 'Explore Roles' page in a Next.js frontend application. It manages role search, filtering, suggested roles, and UI interactions, integrating with backend APIs to fetch roles, filters, and recommendations.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL by joining a base URL and a path, properly handling slashes.

methods.name: safeParseSalaryUsdRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses a salary range string (e.g., '$130k-$210k') and converts it to a range in lakhs INR, using a USD to INR conversion factor.

methods.name: mapSearchRowToUiRole
methods.description: Maps a backend search result row to a client-side Role object with formatted fields and additional info.

methods.name: mapRecommendationToUiRole
methods.description: Maps a recommended role object to the client-side Role format for display.

methods.name: Page
methods.description: Main React component for the Explore Roles page, managing state, fetching data, and rendering search UI, filters, suggested roles, and results.
